_comment: The Runner's Guild delivery loop, end to end. FIXTURE-FIRST (near_runners_guild -- the delivery machinery is the subject, not the street walk; near_guild/near_barracks precedent). Proves, in one continuous run: (1) runners_guild_door real-door round-trip (the former decorative building at street x18-21/y15-16 is enterable; visited_runners_guild banks on entry); (2) the interior bodies -- the resting-runner walk-on's pool line and Vess's counter bark (both bank heard_gossip, the shared social counter); (3) THE DELIVERY BOARD browse (delivery_board:true routes to _interact_delivery_board -- read-only, banks read_the_delivery_board, slate ids pinned via assert_state board_active_deliveries, the board_loop convention: determinism proof on derived state, copy legibility on the windowed shot); (4) TAKE via Vess's picker (vess_counter.json 'Take a slip.' -> the code-built delivery picker, accept_delivery banks accepted_delivery_<id> + grants the parcel item -- item_gained + 'Got:' toast -- and Vess reads the STANDARD issue line for a band-1 slip), PLUS the journal's own Postings section reading the just-accepted slip (title via _delivery_title -- parcel+destination baked into one string -- + OPAQUE 'In hand.'); (5) CARRY + the ARRIVAL HANDOFF: a real walked leg from the Guild to Krshia's stall -- _check_delivery_arrival fires on the move that lands Chebyshev-1 from the anchor (traced first arrival cell on this route: (15,3) vs krshia_stall (14,2)), banking delivered_<id>, removing the parcel (item_lost) and toasting 'Delivered: Plains-Wool Bolt.', then the journal re-read showing the SAME slip flipped to 'Ready to turn in.'; (6) TURN-IN at the counter (turn_in_delivery: gold_changed delta 1 total 1 through the shared earn_gold router -- fixture gold is 0 so the total pins the exact payout -- then completed_delivery_<id>, then Vess's mark-confirmed line), then the journal falling back to its empty flavor line; (7) the SLEEP-FAIL NEGATIVE: accept a second slip (pisces parcel), teleport to the inn bed (debug-only, the board_loop precedent -- the overworld walk is proven elsewhere; the subject here is the sleep beat) and sleep -- the undelivered parcel returns (item_lost + the night-ledger toast BEFORE phase_changed), the slip clears with NO pay and NO completion, delivery_failed arms, and the journal is checked ONE more time to prove a failed/returned slip shows nothing extra (the section just goes back to empty -- Vess's own bark carries the failure fiction, not this section); (8) the slate ROTATES across the sleep (times_slept 1 window pinned) and Vess's one-shot 'Parcel came back on the night ledger' bark fires EXACTLY ONCE at the next picker open (assert_event_count 1 across a deliberate second picker open); (9) a SECOND sleep with no slip held (delivery_failed stays false throughout) rotates the slate again (times_slept 2 window pinned) and Vess's OWN plain-rotation bark ('Board turned over while you slept. Grab a slip before somebody faster does.', distinct copy/voice from both Selys's board line and Vess's failure line) fires EXACTLY ONCE at the next picker open and does NOT re-fire on a second talk in the same waking (the positive + negative pair, mirroring step 8's convention) -- proves the rotation signpost is not merely a byproduct of a failed run. MODE/ABANDON TRACE: all 5 shipped deliveries are DELTA mode (deliveries.json's MODE TRACE -- delivered_<id> is structurally un-bankable pre-accept, and delta is what makes re-acceptance honest; the re-accept no-insta-complete property is unit-proven in test_sim_core.gd, not here); there is NO abandon option by design -- the sleep-fail IS the abandon (no pay, no penalty, parcel returned), which step (7) proves live. Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).

steps._comment: == (0) ROTATION PRE-STATE == times_slept 0 -> pool window [0,1,2] = krshia_wool/pisces_parcel/gate_dispatch (data/deliveries.json order, the board_loop determinism convention).

== (1) IN THROUGH THE DOOR == (18,17) right 2: step 1 -> (19,17), step 2 blocks on runners_guild_door (20,17) & faces it. Interact transitions to runners_guild (5,6) and banks visited_runners_guild (door on_enter_accomplishment).

Emission order (traced from the first run's events.jsonl): map_changed -> ui_mood_applied (presentation reacts to the transition synchronously) -> THEN the door's on_enter_accomplishment (banked after transition() returns, back in interact()) -- so the mood wait sits BEFORE the accomplishment wait or the since-marker skips past it.
== (2) THE RESTING RUNNER == (5,6) left 2 -> (3,6), up 1 -> (3,5), left 1 blocks on resting_runner (2,5) & faces it. His one pool line plays (first talk of the waking).

payload_contains.text: Floodplains double, both legs mud. Wake me for a fire or a Courier.

steps._comment: == (3) THE DELIVERY BOARD == (3,5) right 4 -> (7,5), up 2 -> (7,3), right 1 blocks on runner_board (8,3) & faces it. Browse-only code-built dialogue: header + the 3 live slips + the standing-notice footer.

== (4) TAKE A SLIP == (7,3) left 2 -> (5,3), up 1 blocks on Vess (5,2) & faces her. First interact of the waking plays her counter bark (talk_pool, banks heard_gossip); second opens vess_counter. Fresh options: idx0 'Just passing through.', idx1 'Take a slip.' ('Turn in a slip.' hidden -- delivery_accepted false).

payload_contains.text: Runner's Guild! Board's live. Take a slip, show me, go. Rules, quick: the parcel's yours until it's theirs. Sleep on a run and it comes back here, and you carry the shame instead. No pay for shame.

Accept banks accepted_delivery_<id>, grants the parcel (item_gained + 'Got:' toast), then Vess's STANDARD issue line (band-1, not fragile, not the hamper).

payload_contains.speaker: Vess
payload_contains.text: Signed, stamped, yours. That's a one-leg run, easy pace. Don't walk it TOO easy, the term's same-waking.

steps._comment: == (5) THE CARRY (a real walked leg) == out the exit: (5,3) down 3 -> (5,6), down 1 blocks on runners_guild_exit (5,7) & faces it; interact -> street (19,17).

Walk to the mark: left 2 -> (17,17), up 4 -> (17,13) (watch_sergeant (17,12) is the next cell north -- stop short), left 2 -> (15,13), then up the x15 side street. Blast-radius-traced route: every cell verified against blocked+walls+entities before this script was written. The ARRIVAL fires on the step that lands (15,3) -- the FIRST route cell within Chebyshev 1 of krshia_stall (14,2): delivered_<id> banks, the parcel leaves the pack (item_lost), and the handoff toast fires. 9 up-steps reach (15,4) (distance 2, explicitly NOT arrival) -- the 10th is the arrival move.

== POSTINGS JOURNAL CHECK (fulfilled) == the arrival just banked delivered_delivery_krshia_wool 0->1 -- delta 1 >= 1: the SAME field flips to the OTHER binary literal, before the slip is ever turned in.
steps.name: journal

steps._comment: == (6) TURN IN == walk back (reverse of the outbound leg): down 10 -> (15,13), right 2 -> (17,13), down 4 -> (17,17), right 2 -> (19,17); right 1 blocks on the door & faces it; interact -> runners_guild (5,6); up 3 -> (5,3); up 1 blocks on Vess. Same waking, so ONE interact opens the graph directly. delivery_accepted true: idx0 'Just passing through.', idx1 'Turn in a slip.' ('Take a slip.' hidden).

Emission order (turn_in_bounty's traced twin): turn_in_delivery resolves BEFORE the result graph opens -- gold_changed (delta 1, total 1: the fixture starts at 0 gold so the total pins the exact payout), the earn toast, completed_delivery_<id>, THEN dialogue_started{delivery_turnin} and Vess's mark-confirmed line.

payload_contains.text: Mark confirmed. Hah — sorry, came in at a sprint myself. Coin's counted. Nice legs on that run. Hawk started on a board like this one, you know. Well. A board LIKE it.
